sanityBlog.title: Blog
sanityBlog.draftOnly: Edit private drafts. Published Sanity posts stay unchanged.
sanityBlog.unavailable: The Blog connection is unavailable. Your local recovery remains on this device.
sanityBlog.loadFailed: The posts could not be loaded. Check access to the public dataset and try again.
sanityBlog.saveFailed: The draft could not be saved. Your edits remain on this device.
sanityBlog.createFailed: Creation could not be confirmed. Retry this post to check the result. Its details remain on this device.
sanityBlog.invalid: Check the title, slug, date, categories and link addresses before saving.
sanityBlog.storageFailed: Recovery could not be saved on this device. New edits and closing are paused until storage works again.
sanityBlog.saved: Draft saved. The published post is unchanged.
sanityBlog.conflict: This draft changed elsewhere. Your edits remain on this device. Reopen the post to inspect the current draft.
sanityBlog.permission: You no longer have access to change this draft. Your edits remain on this device.
sanityBlog.offline: Connection interrupted. You can keep editing on this device. Saving needs a connection.
sanityBlog.connectBody: Use a public dataset with the supported blogPost schema. Only published posts are read. No token is needed.
sanityBlog.author: Author
sanityBlog.createPending: Creation has been requested. Retry the same post to confirm the result without creating a duplicate.
sanityBlog.saveUnconfirmed: The last save is not confirmed. Retry Save draft to check its result.
sanityBlog.archivedLiveUntouched: Archived draft. The published post stays unchanged.
sanityBlog.recoveredOnDevice: Unsaved changes, recovered on this device
sanityBlog.recoveryFound: Unsaved edits from an earlier session are available for this version of the draft.
sanityBlog.caption: Image caption
sanityBlog.readonlyBlock: Block {block} is read-only. Its content and settings are preserved.
sanityBlog.emptyContent: This post has no editable text blocks yet.
sanityBlog.preservedFields: Hero image and SEO settings are preserved. Edit those in Sanity Studio.
sanityBlog.selectPost: Choose a post to edit its private draft, or create a new post.
sanityBlog.editRefused: This edit exceeds a content limit or uses unsupported formatting. Your earlier edits are kept.
sanityBlog.recoveryInvalid: These recovered edits do not match this draft. They remain on this device.
